**Article Details for PMID: 41160818**

**Title:** Trastuzumab Deruxtecan plus Pertuzumab for HER2-Positive Metastatic Breast Cancer.

**Authors:** Sara M Tolaney, Zefei Jiang, Qingyuan Zhang, Romualdo Barroso-Sousa, Yeon Hee Park, Mothaffar F Rimawi, Cristina Saura, Andreas Schneeweiss, Masakazu Toi, Yee Soo Chae, Yasemin Kemal, Mukesh Chaudhari, Mehmet A N Şendur, Toshinari Yamashita, Monica Casalnuovo, Michael A Danso, Jie Liu, Jagdish Shetty, Pia Herbolsheimer, Sibylle Loibl, DESTINY-Breast09 Trial Investigators

**Journal:** The New England journal of medicine
**Publication Date:** 2026-03-26
**DOI:** 10.1056/NEJMoa2508668

**Abstract:**
Trastuzumab deruxtecan has shown efficacy in patients with previously treated human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-positive advanced or metastatic breast cancer. The efficacy and safety of trastuzumab deruxtecan in patients with no previous therapy for HER2-positive advanced or metastatic breast cancer are unclear.

**Note:** Full text is not available in PubMed Central. You may need institutional access or subscription to view the complete article.
